motive.canonical: Elias Grant discovered Marcus Bell had been stealing from the cafe till and gave him until this morning to confess before he took the proof to the village committee.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Marcus Bell was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: Correct. Marcus Bell killed Elias Grant. Elias Grant had found the torn ledger page proving Marcus Bell was skimming the till, and gave him until this morning to confess before taking it to the committee. He summoned him to the storage room before opening. Marcus Bell slipped out the front, doubled back through the elias grant's house — the blue coat someone saw at 09:49 — and let himself in the back door. When Elias Grant refused to back down he struck him with the Brass till weight at 09:58 (the thud someone and someone heard), rinsed it in the kitchen and hid it in the mop bucket, then opened the cafe two minutes late. His fountain alibi was never real, and no one could place him there.
